items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I've got an album home, Louis Armstrong and Bessie Smith.

ctx.x: All through his career. When he left New Orleans and went to Chicago, he was backing up blues singers. And all those records he made when he came to New York with Clarence Williams. He was backing up -- I've got an album home, Louis Armstrong and Bessie Smith. So I can't understand how these people could say that. There wasn't any resentment on my part, believe me.

All right, so Fletcher, we're still with Fletcher. What happened with Fletcher? Was there a big difference between those three bands, Benny Carter, Chick Webb and Fletcher Henderson, I mean from a musician's point of view?
